title: TournamentData
description: Standardized tournament intelligence schema extracted from collegiate flyers and captions.

tournament_name.description: The formal name of the badminton tournament.

host_university.description: The institution hosting the event (e.g., VCU, UMD, Towson, UMBC, JHU).

event_location.description: The physical address or facility/building name of the tournament.

registration_deadline.description: The exact date and time registration closes in ISO 8601 format.

ride_form_deadline.description: The deadline for submitting carpool or ride-share requests, if applicable.

is_open_tournament.description: True if the tournament is open to non-collegiate or external players.

registration_url.description: The extracted Google Form, Linktree, or registration portal URL.

source_url.description: The source Instagram post or flyer URL.

flyer_image_url.description: URL or storage path of the downloaded tournament graphic flyer.
